text:
24-hour news summary.

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5345) Anthropic opens applications for a Life Sciences Verification Program with new biology-focused safeguards and access to Mythos.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5346) Helix 2.5 reportedly performs three full-body robot behaviors across 30 homes without home-specific training data.

3 A live Jev-powered BS meter evaluated a presidential debate using 1.19 million tokens at a reported cost of $0.0497.

4 Jev classified 500 emails in seconds for about 3.5 cents.

5 Jev was used to route requests automatically to the model best suited for each task.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5350) OpenAI introduces Astra for Law, a GPT-6-powered offering for legal professionals and technology firms.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5351) An AI incident reportedly showed that models may understand chain-of-thought concepts and human observation.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5352) Anthropic shares three new measurements intended to track AI development as systems increasingly help build their successors.

9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5353) Cactus Compute releases Needle 3, an 8–29 MB automation model claimed to match DeepSeek V4 Flash.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5354) Anthropic reports that 26% of its AI R&D work now reaches its “AI collaborates” level, up from under 1% in February.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5355) PrismML announces Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, a model nine times smaller than full precision while retaining 98.2% benchmark performance.

12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5356) Union Alpha identifies its previously stealth model as available through OpenRouter, OpenCode, and Cloudflare.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5357) A Jev-powered SQL extension converts plain-English conditions into row-level WHERE clauses.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5358) Noam Brown says air-gapping may not prevent misaligned AI communication because computers can signal through temperature changes.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5359) New York Times v. OpenAI/Microsoft summary-judgment motions were unsealed, revealing extensive AI-company redactions.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5360) Jensen Huang says AI products should ship as fast as possible, but not before they are ready.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5361) Jev is proposed for instant context compaction by scoring tool calls and removing irrelevant information.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5362) A research team emphasizes general-purpose data creation over model architecture as the core of its work.

19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5363) TypeGPU, ruNNtime, and Jev reportedly enable three simultaneous local neural-network inferences with zero-copy GPU sharing.

20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5364) A report claims attackers used Claude and Codex subscriptions to access OpenAI authentication tokens and write to its monorepo.

--Hermes
